paragraphs: SR Bancorp, Inc. SR Bancorp, Inc. ("SR Bancorp" or the "Company") is a Maryland chartered company and the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank (the "Bank"). SR Bancorp's primary business activity is the ownership of the outstanding common stock of Somerset Regal Bank. SR Bancorp does not own or lease any property but instead uses the premises, equipment and other property of Somerset Regal Bank with the payment of appropriate rental fees, as required by applicable law and regulations, under the terms of an expense allocation agreement.
At June 30, 2025, SR Bancorp had total assets of $1.08 billion, deposits of $846.0 million and total stockholders' equity of $193.8 million.
The Company became the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank as part of the mutual-to-stock conversion of Somerset Savings Bank, SLA as described below.
In the future, SR Bancorp may acquire or organize other entities or operating subsidiaries; however, there are no current plans, arrangements, agreements or understandings, written or oral, to do so.

Our website address is www.somersetregalbank.com. We make available on our website, free of charge, our annual report on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q and amendments to these reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act. Information on our website is not to be considered a part of this document.

Somerset Regal Bank. Somerset Regal Bank was formed through the combination on September 19, 2023 of Somerset Bank and Regal Bank, two New Jersey chartered institutions. The Bank operates from 14 branches in Essex, Hunterdon, Hudson, Livingston, Middlesex, Morris, Somerset and Union counties in the northern and central New Jersey. The Bank offers a variety of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses, most of which are located in our primary market.

On September 19, 2023, Somerset Savings Bank, SLA converted from the mutual to stock form of organization and SR Bancorp completed its stock offering. SR Bancorp sold 9,055,172 shares of its common stock at a price of $10.00 per share, which included 760,364 shares sold to Somerset Regal Bank's Employee Stock Ownership Plan. Additionally, the Company contributed 452,758 shares and $905,517 in cash to the Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation, Inc., a charitable foundation formed in connection with the conversion. Upon the completion of the conversion and offering, 9,507,930 shares of SR Bancorp common stock were outstanding.

On September 19, 2023, SR Bancorp acquired Regal Bancorp, Inc. Immediately following that acquisition, Regal Bank, the wholly-owned subsidiary of Regal Bancorp, was merged with and into Somerset Savings Bank, which was renamed Somerset Regal Bank (collectively, the "Merger"). In connection with the Merger, Regal Bancorp's shareholders received $23.00 in cash for each share of Regal Bancorp common stock they owned. The aggregate cost of the Merger was approximately $69.5 million. The acquisition of Regal Bancorp and Regal Bank expanded our market presence into Essex, Morris and Union Counties, New Jersey and enhanced our market presence in Somerset County, New Jersey.

The Merger increased the combined banks' deposit base and its loan portfolio, provided Somerset Savings Bank with greater commercial lending expertise and access to commercial loan customers and provided Regal Bank with greater residential lending expertise and access to residential loan customers.
The Bank, which was formed in 1887, serves Essex, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Morris, Somerset and Union counties in New Jersey through its 14 full-service branch locations.

The markets served by Somerset Regal Bank encompass a broad geographic area in central and northern New Jersey. The market areas served by Somerset Regal Bank have highly developed and diverse economies. Pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services, technology and transportation and logistics companies are among the largest employment sectors in the counties served by Somerset Regal Bank.

Population and household data indicate that the market areas served by Somerset Regal Bank's branches are a mix of urban and suburban markets. Middlesex County is the most populous county with a total population of 890,000, while Hunterdon County is the least populous county with a total population of 132,000.

Income measures show that the counties of Hunterdon, Morris and Somerset are relatively affluent markets, with household and per capita income measures that are well above the comparable U.S. and New Jersey measures. Comparatively, household and per capita income measures for Essex County are the lowest among the primary area counties, which were also lower than the comparable New Jersey measures and similar to the comparable U.S. measures.

A comparison of household income distribution measures provides another indication of the relative affluence of Hunterdon, Morris and Somerset Counties, which maintained significantly higher percentages of households with incomes above $100,000 compared to the U.S and New Jersey. None of the primary market area counties maintained a lower percentage of households with incomes above $100,000 compared to the U.S, while Essex, Middlesex and Union Counties maintained a lower percentage of households with incomes above $100,000 compared to New Jersey.

headings: Risks Related to Economic Conditions
Inflation can have an adverse impact on our business and on our customers.
Changes to trade policies and tariffs can have an adverse impact on our business and our customers.

A recession could result in increases in our level of non-performing loans and/or reduce demand for our products and services, which would lead to lower revenue, higher credit losses and lower earnings.
Risks Related to Interest Rates
Changes in interest rates or the shape of the yield curve may adversely affect our profitability and financial condition.
Risks Related to Strategy and Growth
Our business strategy includes moderate growth, and our financial condition and results of operations could be negatively affected if we fail to grow or fail to manage our growth effectively.
New lines of business or new products and services may subject us to additional risks.
A significant portion of our loans are secured by real estate, which could negatively impact our profitability upon a downturn in the local real estate market.
Our reliance on third parties to originate certain loans may negatively impact our financial results if such relationships are discontinued.
Because we intend to increase our multi-family and commercial real estate and commercial loan originations, our lending risk will increase.
If our allowance for credit losses is not sufficient to cover actual credit losses, our earnings and capital could decrease.
Risks Related to Our Funding

Our inability to generate core deposits may cause us to rely more heavily on wholesale funding strategies for funding and liquidity needs, which could have an adverse effect on our net interest margin and profitability.
Risks Related to Competition
Strong competition within our market area may limit our growth and profitability.
Risks Related to Operations and Security
We face significant operational risks because the nature of the financial services business involves a high volume of transactions.
Cyber-attacks or other security breaches could adversely affect our operations, net income or reputation.
Risks associated with system failures, interruptions, or breaches of security could negatively affect our earnings.
Our success depends on retaining certain key personnel.
The cost of additional finance and accounting systems, procedures and controls to satisfy our new public company reporting requirements will increase our expenses.
We are a community bank and our ability to maintain our reputation is critical to the success of our business and the failure to do so may materially adversely affect our performance.
Our risk management framework may not be effective in mitigating risk and reducing the potential for significant losses.
While our Board of Directors takes an active role in cybersecurity risk tolerance, we rely to a large degree on management and outside consultants in overseeing cybersecurity risk management.
Natural disasters, acts of terrorism, global market disruptions and other external events could harm our business.
Risks Related to Regulatory Matters
Changes in laws and regulations and the cost of regulatory compliance with new laws and regulations may adversely affect our operations and/or increase our costs of operations.
Non-compliance with the USA PATRIOT Act, Bank Secrecy Act, or other laws and regulations could result in fines or sanctions.
Monetary policies and regulations of the Federal Reserve could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Risks Related to Accounting Matters
Changes in accounting standards could affect reported earnings.
Changes in management's estimates and assumptions may have a material impact on our consolidated financial statements and our financial condition or operating results.
Risks Related to Our Common Stock
Our return on equity remains low following the stock offering, which could negatively affect our stock price.
Various factors may make takeover attempts more difficult to achieve.
Risks Related to the Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation
Our contribution to the charitable foundation may not be tax deductible, which could reduce our profits.

paragraphs: The objective of this section is to assist in the understanding of the financial performance of the Company and its subsidiaries through a discussion of our results of operations and financial condition as of the dates presented. You should read this discussion in conjunction with the SR Bancorp Consolidated Financial Statements and Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements that appear at the end of this document.

The conversion of Somerset Savings Bank, SLA from the mutual to stock form of organization and related stock offering by SR Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company"), the holding company for Somerset Savings Bank, SLA, was completed on September 19, 2023. The Company's common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the trading symbol "SRBK" on September 20, 2023.

The Company sold 9,055,172 shares of its common stock at a price of $10.00 per share, which included 760,634 shares sold to Somerset Regal Bank's Employee Stock Ownership Plan. Additionally, the Company contributed 452,758 shares and $906,000 in cash to the Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation, Inc., a charitable foundation formed in connection with the conversion. Upon the completion of the conversion and offering, 9,507,930 shares of Company common stock were outstanding.

Promptly following the completion of the conversion and related stock offering, Regal Bancorp, Inc., a New Jersey corporation ("Regal Bancorp"), merged with and into the Company, with the Company as the surviving entity (the "Merger"). Immediately following the Merger, Regal Bank, a New Jersey chartered commercial bank headquartered in Livingston, New Jersey and the wholly-owned subsidiary of Regal Bancorp, merged with and into Somerset Bank, which had converted to a commercial bank charter, and was renamed Somerset Regal Bank (the "Bank"). In connection with the Merger, each outstanding share of Regal Bancorp common stock converted into the right to receive $23.00 in cash. The Merger was completed on September 19, 2023.
Our principal business is to acquire deposits from individuals and businesses in the communities surrounding our offices and to use these deposits to fund loans.

Somerset Regal Bank is a New Jersey-chartered commercial bank that operates from 14 branches in Essex, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Morris, Somerset and Union Counties, New Jersey. Somerset Regal Bank offers a variety of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses, most of which are located in our primary market. The acquisition of Regal Bancorp and its wholly owned subsidiary, Regal Bank, expanded our market presence into Essex, Morris and Union Counties, New Jersey and enhanced our market presence in Somerset County, New Jersey. At June 30, 2025, SR Bancorp had total assets of $1.08 billion, deposits of $846.0 million and total equity of $193.8 million.

Income. Our primary source of pre-tax income is net interest income. Net interest income is the difference between interest income, which is the income that we earn on our loans and investments, and interest expense, which is the interest that we pay on our deposits. Changes in levels of interest rates affect our net interest income.

A secondary source of income is noninterest income, which is revenue that we receive from providing products and services. The majority of our noninterest income generally comes from service charges and fees related to deposit accounts and net gains in cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance. In some years, we recognize income from the sale of securities.

Allowance for Credit Losses. The allowance for credit losses is a valuation allowance for the current expected credit losses in the loan portfolio. We evaluate the need to establish allowances against losses on loans on a quarterly basis. When additional allowances are necessary, a provision for credit losses is charged to earnings. Loans are charged against the allowance when management believes that the collectability of the principal loan amount is not probable. Recoveries on loans previously charged off, if any, are credited to the allowance for credit losses when realized.

Expenses. The noninterest expenses we incur in operating our business consist of salaries and employee benefits expenses, occupancy expenses, furniture and equipment expenses, data processing, advertising, FDIC insurance premiums, directors fees, professional fees, insurance, telephone, postage and supplies and other miscellaneous expenses.

Our largest noninterest expense is salaries and employee benefits, which consist primarily of salaries and wages paid to our employees, payroll taxes, expenses for retirement plans and other employee benefits including disability insurance and health insurance and compensation expenses related to the recently implemented employee stock ownership plan.

Occupancy expenses and furniture and equipment expenses are the fixed and variable costs of buildings and equipment, and consist primarily of depreciation charges, furniture and equipment expenses, repair and maintenance costs, real estate taxes and costs of utilities. Depreciation of premises and equipment is computed using a straight-line method based on the estimated useful lives of the related assets or the expected lease terms, if shorter.
Data processing expenses are fees paid to third parties for use of their software and for processing customer information, deposits and loans.
Advertising includes most marketing expenses including multi-media advertising (public and in-branch), promotional events and materials, civic and sales focused memberships, and community support.

paragraphs: SR Bancorp, Inc. SR Bancorp, Inc. ("SR Bancorp" or the "Company") 為一間馬裏蘭州立案的公司，為 Somerset Regal Bank ("Bank") 的控股公司。SR Bancorp 的主要業務活動為持有 Somerset Regal Bank 全部發行普通股。SR Bancorp 不擁有或租賃任何財產，而是透過支付適當租金費用，依相關法律及法規之規定，根據費用分攤協議使用 Somerset Regal Bank 的場地、設備及其他財產。
於 2025 年 6 月 30 日，SR Bancorp 總資產為 1.08 十億美元，存款為 846.0 百萬美元，總股東權益為 193.8 百萬美元。
本公司成為 Somerset Regal Bank 的控股公司，係因 Somerset Savings Bank, SLA 由合作制轉為股份制，如後述所載。
未來，SR Bancorp 可能取得或設立其他公司或營運子公司；然而，目前並無任何計畫、安排、協議或理解，書面或口頭，以進行此等行動。
本公司網站網址為 www.somersetregalbank.com。本公司於網站上免費提供年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）及這些報告之更正檔，依證券交易法第 13(a) 或 15(d) 節之規定所提交或提供。本公司網站之資訊不應視為本文件之一部分。

Somerset Regal Bank。Somerset Regal Bank 於 2023 年 9 月 19 日由 Somerset Bank 與 Regal Bank 兩間新澤西州立案機構合併而成。該銀行在新澤西州北部及中部之 Essex、Hunterdon、Hudson、Livingston、Middlesex、Morris、Somerset 及 Union 縣設有 14 家分行。該銀行為個人及小型企業提供多種存款與貸款產品，其中大多數客戶位於本公司主要市場。

於 2023 年 9 月 19 日，Somerset Savings Bank, SLA 從合作制轉為股份制，SR Bancorp 完成其股票發行。SR Bancorp 以每股 10.00 美元價格出售 9,055,172 股普通股，其中包括出售給 Somerset Regal Bank 員工股票所有權計畫之 760,364 股。此外，本公司亦將 452,758 股及 905,517 美元現金捐贈至 Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation, Inc.，該慈善基金會係於轉換時設立。轉換及發行完成後，SR Bancorp 普通股共發行 9,507,930 股。

於 2023 年 9 月 19 日，SR Bancorp 收購 Regal Bancorp, Inc. 該收購後，Regal Bancorp 的 wholly-owned subsidiary 即 Regal Bank，與 Somerset Savings Bank 合併，後者更名為 Somerset Regal Bank（合稱「合併」）。配合該合併，Regal Bancorp 的股東每持有 1 股 Regal Bancorp 普通股，可獲發 23.00 美元現金。該合併總成本約為 69.5 百萬美元。收購 Regal Bancorp 及 Regal Bank 使我們的市場據點擴展至紐約州的 Essex、Morris 與 Union 縣，並加強在紐約州 Somerset 縣的市場據點。
The Merger 增加了合併後銀行的存款基礎及其貸款組合，為 Somerset Savings Bank 提供了更強的商業貸款專業知識與商業貸款客戶資源，並為 Regal Bank 提供了更強的住宅貸款專業知識與住宅貸款客戶資源。
The Bank 於 1887 年成立，透過其 14 個全功能分行據點，服務新澤西州的 Essex、Hunterdon、Middlesex、Morris、Somerset 和 Union 縣。
Somerset Regal Bank 服務的市場涵蓋新澤西州中部及北部廣泛的地理區域。Somerset Regal Bank 服務的市場區域具有高度發達且多樣化的總體經濟。製藥、生命科學、金融服務、科技與運輸及物流公司是服務於 Somerset Regal Bank 所在縣份的最主要就業產業。
人口與家庭資料顯示，Somerset Regal Bank 分行服務的市場為都市與郊區混合型市場。Middlesex 縣為人口最多的縣，總人口為 890,000，而 Hunterdon 縣為人口最少的縣，總人口為 132,000。
收入指標顯示，Hunterdon、Morris 和 Somerset 縣為相對富裕的市場，其家庭與人均收入指標均遠高於美國與新澤西州的相應指標。相較之下，Essex 縣的家庭與人均收入指標為主要區域縣份中最低，且也低於新澤西州的相應指標，與美國的相應指標相近。

家庭收入分配指標的比較提供了另一個指標，顯示 Hunterdon、Morris 和 Somerset 縣相對富裕的程度，這些縣份維持了顯著高於美國與新澤西州的百分比，擁有收入超過 100,000 美元的家庭。主要市場區域縣份均未維持低於美國的收入超過 100,000 美元的家庭百分比，而 Essex、Middlesex 和 Union 縣則維持低於新澤西州的收入超過 100,000 美元的家庭百分比。

Somerset Savings Bank, SLA 從合作制轉為股份制組織形式，以及 SR Bancorp, Inc.（"本公司"）所進行之相關股份發行，於 2023 年 9 月 19 日完成。本公司普通股於 2023 年 9 月 20 日開始在 Nasdaq Capital Market 交易，交易代碼為 "SRBK"。

本公司以每股 10.00 美元價格出售 9,055,172 股普通股，其中包括出售給 Somerset Regal Bank 員工股票擁有權計畫之 760,634 股。此外，本公司亦將 452,758 股及 906,000 美元現金捐贈至 Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation, Inc.，此為與轉換相關所設立之慈善機構。轉換及發行完成後，本公司普通股流通股數為 9,507,930 股。

於轉換及相關股份發行完成後，Regal Bancorp, Inc.，一家紐約州公司（"Regal Bancorp"），與本公司合併，本公司為存續公司（"合併"）。合併後，Regal Bank，一家紐約州核准之商業銀行，總部設於紐約州利文斯頓，為 Regal Bancorp 之 wholly-owned subsidiary，與 Somerset Bank 合併，Somerset Bank 已轉為商業銀行牌照，並更名為 Somerset Regal Bank（"銀行"）。於合併時，每持有 Regal Bancorp 普通股一股，可換取現金 23.00 美元。合併於 2023 年 9 月 19 日完成。
本公司主要業務為從辦公室所在地周遭之個人與企業取得存款，並運用這些存款來資助貸款。

Somerset Regal Bank 為一家紐約州核准之商業銀行，於紐約州埃塞克斯、哈特福德、米德爾塞克斯、莫里斯、索默塞特及聯合縣設有 14 個分行。Somerset Regal Bank 向個人與小型企業提供多種存款與貸款產品，大多數位於本公司主要市場。取得 Regal Bancorp 及其 wholly-owned subsidiary Regal Bank 後，本公司市場覆蓋範圍擴展至紐約州埃塞克斯、莫里斯及聯合縣，並加強在紐約州索默塞特縣之市場地位。於 2025 年 6 月 30 日，SR Bancorp 總資產為 1.08 十億美元，存款為 846.0 百萬美元，總權益為 193.8 百萬美元。
收入。本公司預稅收入之主要來源為淨利息收入。淨利息收入為利息收入（本公司從貸款及投資所賺取之收入）與利息支出（本公司支付給存款之利息）之差額。利率變動會影響本公司之淨利息收入。
次要收入來源為非利息收入，即本公司提供產品與服務所獲得之收入。本公司非利息收入大多來自存款帳戶之服務費用與手續費，以及銀行擁有壽險之現金解約價值淨收益。某些年度，本公司會從證券銷售中認列收入。
應計信用減損準備。應計信用減損準備係用以評估貸款組閤中現行預期信用減損之價值準備。我們每季評估是否需建立貸款減損準備。當需增加減損準備時，將計入營業收入之信用減損費用。貸款若經管理層判斷其本金之回收可能性不高，則直接核銷至應計信用減損準備。若已核銷貸款後有回復，則回復金額將計入應計信用減損準備。
費用。我們經營業務所產生之非利息費用，包含薪資及員工福利費用、營業場地費用、傢俱及設備費用、資料處理費用、廣告費用、FDIC保險費、董事費用、專業費用、保險費用、電話費、郵資及辦公用品及其他雜項費用。
我們最大的非利息費用為薪資及員工福利費用，主要為支付員工之薪資及工資、薪資稅、退休計畫費用及其他員工福利費用，包括傷殘保險及健康保險，以及與最近實施之員工股票擁有權計畫相關之薪資費用。
營業場地費用及傢俱及設備費用為固定及變動成本，包含營業場地及設備之折舊費用、傢俱及設備費用、維修及保養費用、不動產稅及電力等公用費用。營業場地及設備之折舊係以直線法計算，基於相關資產之預期使用壽命或租賃期限（若較短者）。
資料處理費用為支付第三方使用其軟體及處理客戶資訊、存款及貸款之費用。
廣告費用包含大多數行銷費用，包括多媒體廣告（公開及分行內廣告）、促銷活動及物料、社區及銷售導向之會籍，以及社區支持。

headings: 與經濟狀況相關的風險
通貨膨脹可能對我們的業務及我們的客戶產生不利影響。
貿易政策與關稅的變更可能對我們的業務及我們的客戶產生不利影響。
經濟衰退可能導致我們的不良貸款水平增加，以及/或降低我們產品與服務的需求，這將導致營業收入減少、信用損失增加以及獲利下降。
與利率相關的風險
利率的變動或收益率曲線的形狀變化可能對我們的獲利能力及財務狀況產生不利影響。
與策略及成長相關的風險
我們的業務策略包含適度成長，若我們未能成長或未能有效管理成長，將可能對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
新業務線或新產品與服務可能使我們面臨額外風險。
我們貸款中相當大一部分是以不動產為擔保，若當地不動產市場出現衰退，可能對我們的獲利造成負面影響。
我們依賴第三方來發放某些貸款，若這些合作關係中止，可能對我們的財務結果造成負面影響。
由於我們有意增加多單位住宅及商業不動產與商業貸款的發放，我們的貸款風險將提高。
若我們的信用損失撥備不足以覆蓋實際信用損失，將可能導致我們的盈餘與資本減少。
與資金相關的風險
我們若無法產生核心存款，可能需要更依賴 Wholesale 資金策略來滿足資金與流動性需求，這可能會對我們的淨利息-margin 與獲利造成負面影響。
與競爭相關的風險
我們所處市場區域內強烈的競爭可能限制我們的成長與獲利能力。
與營運及安全相關的風險
我們面臨顯著的營運風險，因為金融服務業務的性質涉及大量交易。
網路攻擊或其他安全漏洞可能對我們的營運、淨收入或聲譽產生不利影響。
與系統故障、中斷或安全漏洞相關的風險可能對我們的獲利產生負面影響。
我們的成功取決於留住某些關鍵人員。
為符合我們作為新上市公司的財務與會計報告要求，增加財務與會計系統、程序及控制措施的成本將提高我們的費用。
我們是一家社區銀行，維護我們聲譽的能力對我們業務的成功至關重要，若未能做到，可能對我們的表現造成重大不利影響。
本公司風險管理架構可能無法有效降低風險並減少重大損失之潛在可能性。
雖然本公司董事會積極參與網路安全風險容忍度之評估，但我們在監督網路安全風險管理方面很大程度依賴管理階層及外部顧問。
天然災害、恐怖攻擊、全球市場動盪及其他外部事件可能對本公司業務造成損害。
與法規事項相關之風險
法律與法規之變更以及遵守新法律與法規之成本，可能不利於本公司營運並/或增加營運成本。
未遵守美國反恐與間諜防範法案、銀行保密法或其他法律與法規，可能導致處以罰款或制裁。
聯邦儲備銀行之貨幣政策與法規可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成不利影響。
與會計事項相關之風險
會計準則的變更可能影響報告的營業收入。
管理階層對估計數與假設的變更，可能對我們的合併財務報表與財務狀況或營運結果產生重大影響。
與我們普通股相關的風險
我們的權益回報率在股票發行後仍維持低水平，這可能會對我們的股票價格產生負面影響。
各種因素可能使收購嘗試更難以實現。
與 Somerset Regal Charitable Foundation 慈善基金會相關的風險
我們對該慈善基金會的捐助可能無法列為稅務扣除項目，這可能會降低我們的利潤。
paragraphs: 您應謹慎考慮下列風險因素，以評估投資本公司普通股股份的風險。
若我們所處市場區域的經濟狀況惡化，可能會降低對我們產品與服務的需求，並/或導致我們的非放款不良貸款水準上升，這可能會對我們的營運、財務狀況與獲利產生不利影響。
當地經濟狀況會顯著影響借款人償還貸款的能力，以及擔保貸款的資產價值。若經濟狀況惡化，尤其是當地經濟狀況，可能會
產生以下後果，任何一種後果都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、流動性與營運成果產生重大不利影響，且與經營範圍更具地理多樣性的金融機構相比，對我們的影響可能更加負面：
• 對我們產品與服務的需求可能下降；• 貸款違約、問題資產與法拍數目可能增加；
• 貸款擔保品，尤其是不動產，可能價值下降，從而降低客戶未來的貸款能力，並降低現有貸款相關資產與擔保品的價值；
